Here's where the staging deploy stands.

All 212 of 212 tests are passing. One flaky test needed a retry, but it cleared on the second attempt.

We're waiting on QA sign-off, which is expected by 3 pm today. The deploy window closes at 5 pm, so if sign-off lands on time we have enough room to ship today. I'll post here as soon as QA gives the go-ahead.
